selection_status: selected exploratory parameter baseline; W low-temperature experimental G0 consistency check is not passed

Ag_Ce.source: Lin et al. (2008), Fig. 2(c), digitized candidate

Ag_G.source: Lin et al. (2008), Fig. 2(d), digitized candidate

Ag_ke.source: XTANT-3 supplied Ag K table kappa_tot column

W_Ce.source: Lin et al. (2008), Fig. 7(c), digitized candidate

W_G.source: Lin et al. (2008), Fig. 7(d), digitized candidate

W_ke.source: Daraszewicz et al. (2014), Drude model equation (6)
W_ke.high_temperature_use: extrapolative closure; high-Te nonequilibrium validity is not independently established
W_ke.Ag_ke_source: XTANT-3 K_Ag.dat kappa_tot column; Te-only, not a ke(Te,Tl) surface

W_G0_reference.source: Daraszewicz et al. (2014), measured and ab-initio near-equilibrium anchors
W_G0_reference.interpretation: Lin's digitized low-Te value does not reproduce the Daraszewicz experimental G0 within its quoted 1-sigma range. The Lin value is itself extrapolated below 600 K; retain the discrepancy as a model/source limitation rather than rescaling the Lin curve.

timescale_at_reference_states.Cl_source: Tolias 2017 recommended solid-W White-Minges Cp and density fits; Cp is used as a narrow-range Cv proxy

limitations: The W Lin G curve below 600 K is extrapolated and differs from Daraszewicz's experimental G0; no empirical rescaling was applied.
The Ag Lin curves are digitized from plots; the low-temperature G plateau and short 5000–6607 K bridge are documented approximations.
Ag ke is Te-only and XTANT warns that room-temperature values may not be reliable.
No Ag/W electron-interface conductance, mixed-cell electronic transport rule, or jointly validated Ag/W TTM-MD closure is supplied.
The 0D energy pilot uses one normalized temporal Gaussian and tests energy accounting only; it is not the spatial laser calculation and does not test melting.
